review_method: Direct view_image inspection of 13 individual actual Godot screenshots: ten mid-battle views, two 426x240 settlement views and one S42 entry supplement. No contact sheets, map/core/animation edits, or screenshot image edits.

limitations: Static images verify presentation, not actual command execution, NPC survival, AI safety, objective order, victory transitions or campaign progression. Root maintains separate ordinary-input evidence for the final two rounds and continuous campaign.
Each mid-battle frame shows a local camera view; UI panels obscure some terrain. Full-map spatial review is recorded separately in east/west/rescue reports.
Unit animation quality was outside this assignment and remains unchanged.
There is no moving task wagon in chapter four; S42 contains a stationary clinic scene prop only.
